_comments: A/B: Vapi's own hang-up. Without phone-call-control, Vapi sends the SIP BYE ~0.1 s after the goodbye audio stops (pcap of 01a15cfc: +118 ms), and the caller's audio runs ~0.5-1 s behind, so the last ~0.2-0.7 s can be clipped on some carriers. Padding: the goodbye ends with a throwaway '… bye!' (the ellipsis gives a natural beat) so only that can be clipped, never 'goodbye for now'. A trailing silent pause isn't available: Vapi voices have no SSML or pause option (VapiVoice in the API spec: voiceId, version, speed, language, pronunciationDictionary, chunkPlan; only WellSaid exposes enableSsml). endCallPhrases still contains 'goodbye for now' as the backstop; Vapi waits for the assistant to finish speaking before a phrase hangs up.
endCallMessage: Thanks for calling Summit Air. Take care, and goodbye for now… bye!
